arguments.description: A compact pixel-art Ready status icon: a clearly recognizable check mark with asymmetrical arms conveying successful completion. Use the uploaded style anchor for the queue family art language: perceptible cool blue accent, deliberate coherent clusters and stepped edges, restrained shading/detail. Keep the success silhouette distinct from activity, retry and pause symbols without depending on color. Do not add text. No fixed palette is imposed.
